summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing of Vortex Cloud Gaming MVP. Backend pytest suite: 16/16 passing (auth register/login/me, games list+detail+404, nodes with live metrics, library add/favorite/remove, session start+metrics+end, cloud saves CRUD, stats). Frontend playwright: login (admin@vortex.gg/vortex123) → dashboard with stats/featured/best-node/recommended, register with fresh email auto-login, catalog search by title ('elden' narrows to 1 card) and genre chip (RPG) filtering works, launch dialog from catalog opens, server node selection + 'Jogar agora' starts session and navigates to /play, StreamSession HUD visible (FPS indicator), quick-save creates cloud save, end-session returns to dashboard, Server Status page shows 5 nodes with ping/GPU/queue/load, Cloud Saves 'Novo save' modal creates save, protected routes redirect unauthenticated users to /login (both direct visit without cookie and after logout). Portuguese UI verified.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext relies on httpOnly cookie for /auth/me — behavior is correct and secure. Note: clearing only localStorage keeps user logged in via cookie (expected since cookie is primary auth).
server.py uses @app.on_event('startup') (deprecated in FastAPI); consider lifespan handlers for future-proofing.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combination; explicit origins should be configured in CORS_ORIGINS env for production.
Session metrics endpoint re-queries nodes each call — fine for MVP, could cache per-session.
No rate limiting on auth endpoints (no brute-force lockout). Playbook mentions 5-fail lockout — not implemented.
test_credentials: admin@vortex.gg / vortex123 (works). Registered multiple TEST_<uuid>@vortex.gg users for isolation.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 12 games, 5 nodes, admin user on startup. Tests created transient TEST_ users / library / saves entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows work end-to-end. Note that catalog title text is rendered via CSS text-transform:uppercase so Playwright inner_text returns 'ELDEN RING'; use data-testid selectors (launch-game-button-{id}) rather than text matching. Launch buttons on cards are opacity-0 until hover but respond to force=True click. Logout button text is 'Sair'. CORS currently '*' with credentials — may cause issues if browser enforces stricter policies.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found during testing.
